title: HTTP2Shell is real: I turned one WordPress pingback into a Bash shell
description: A security researcher demonstrated a remote code execution (RCE) exploit chain against a specific WordPress Docker image dated 21 October 2026. The exploit leverages the WordPress pingback.ping XML-RPC method to achieve unauthenticated Bash shell access. This proof-of-concept targets one exact vulnerable Docker image digest and does not affect the latest official WordPress builds or WordPress core itself.
